text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer!! When is my next race?!
choice_data_list: You're full of motivation, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I went to watch a Kiddie Race tournament! 
Everyone was trying so hard... it made me 
feel nostalgic!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The whole venue, including me, went wild 
with cheers!! Ngh~! I just can't get 
enough of this!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Definitely, for sure! The next round of 
roaring cheers will be all for me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gran Alegria's eyes sparkled. It seemed 
she had a wonderful day off."
